title: Habitual Offender Detained Under Goonda Act, Shifted To Karwar Jail
description: According to the order, Madivalayya, a resident of Shivashakthi Nagar in Vijayapura, is a habitual offender involved in several cases relating to offences against persons and public property. The district administration said his activities were likely to disturb public order, prompting the authorities to invoke the provisions of the Karnataka Goonda Act and place him under preventive detention
